Card Q&A.a: No, this card's [On Deletion] effect only returns this card to play. Any cards that were in its digivolution cards go to the trash.
Card Q&A.q: When playing this card from my trash using its [On Deletion] effect, do the cards it had as digivolution cards return to my battle area as well?

Effect: [When Digivolving] Return 1 of your opponent's Digimon to the bottom of their deck. (Trash all of the digivolution cards of that Digimon.)
[On Deletion] If this card had digivolution cards, you may play this card from your trash without paying its memory cost.
